images.caption:
The Central Hall of Ploieşti, Romania.
Architect: Toma T. Socolescu. 
This market place is located in the very heart of the city, strada Emile Zola, Ploieşti, Judeţul Prahova, Romania. It is classified historical monument.

We are the only heirs and descendants of Toma T. Socolescu (died in 1960 in Bucharest) and therefore owner of all his intellectual rights.
